5558.title: Authenticated managed identities are discarded during credential discovery
5558.rootCauseOneLine: The GitHub identity validator excludes underscores; its swallowed validation failure discards successfully discovered credentials and reports the server as not configured.
5558.proposedFix: Maintainer-reviewed expansion of the authentication identity schema to accept managed logins, preserving other identity validation and adding regression coverage. Not eligible for automatic simple-fix publication.
5558.caveats: Reproduced twice through production credential APIs using synthetic successful command responses; no real enterprise account, live container or UI browser session. Automatic PR skipped because the repair changes authentication identity validation.
